title: new AUR fix, please forward to get_iplayer Maintainer: alexmerry
body: due to: "New account registration is temporarily closed. Registration on the AUR is paused while we deal with a wave of automated account creation" I cannot post a solution to fix https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/get_iplayer not using https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/x8 … icparsley/ atomicparsley archlinux.org/packages/extra/x86_64/atomicparsley/ atomicparsley a solution is to use https://github.com/get-iplayer/atomicparsley/ AtomicParsley https://github.com/get-iplayer/atomicpa … static.zip github.com/get-iplayer/atomicparsley/releases/download/0.9.7-get_iplayer.4/AtomicParsley-0.9.7-get_iplayer.4-linux-x86_64-static.zip as described at https://github.com/get-iplayer/get_ipla … arsley-old github.com/get-iplayer/get_iplayer/wiki/unix#user-content-atomicparsley-old please forward to get_iplayer Maintainer: alexmerry longer answer upon request ............ thanks
